findings.claim: Every arm is live and the six are jointly satisfiable.
No single-edit weakening of any arm is detectable from inside the lane: the counter has no selftest and no arm-isolating mode.
findings.evidence: 8/8 mutants leave the frozen instrument bytes untouched and are visible only to the external battery; base-revision runs are byte-identical for 7 of 8 (only M4 moves total 5 -> 4)

arm2 green => covered==64 and score==8 => box3_full_page => covered==total => sections_total==64 => lost==0 => arm1 green. Conversely arm1 red with exit!=0 means covered<64, so arm2 fires; and arm1 red through `lost=0 ok` requires cc>=64 with a differing set, which forces sections_total>64, so box3_full_page is false, score is 6 and arm2 fires. Fixtures base, C and G show the two arms firing and passing together.

findings.claim: Each of the other five arms uniquely pins a named property, with a fixture that isolates it.
findings.evidence: arm2 covered==64 -> page cardinality (P); arm2 score==8 -> box-3 mark and ledger link (S2); arm3 read_rev==c0 -> re-key binding (W); arm4 per-report sha -> report/bytes binding (R); arm5 -> unstable-input exclusion (U); arm6 row_score==score -> R55.3 (T); arm6 ancestry -> R55.5 (A)

findings.claim: The verdict line is the only aggregate; a weakened arm can vanish from `total` without any field showing it.

findings.claim: The C1 claim's precheck clause (`lost=0`) is not independently enforced by the frozen counter.
findings.evidence: F3: arm 1 never fires without arm 2. Recommendation only: instruments are frozen, so the round's record should state the coupling rather than imply six independent checks.

limits: Fixture level only: G and every probe are synthetic commits in a scratch clone (ledger entries, trace receipts, reader reports, SCORECARD rows). Nothing here says the lane at C0 reads 64/64 score 8; that is wave 2.

The probes isolate one arm each; they are not a property test over the input space. Not exercised: missing blobs, unresolvable revs, invalid ledger JSON, `ls-tree` failures, a lane whose page has fewer than 64 sections, and multi-arm simultaneous defects beyond the base revision.

The 46 base-credited entries are the lane's real entries; the 18 re-keyed entries, the 18 reader reports, the fixture calibration rows and (in S2 only) the 34 re-credited SHONEN-pinning entries are synthetic.
The S2 fixture pins fixture entries to corpus/QUALITY.md; a real C0 re-key that pins SHONEN.md would drift on any later SHONEN edit (this is what the first S build hit).
